system: You are a security investigator reviewing an alert. Base every claim only on the evidence available to you. Cite the record IDs that support each observation.

supporting_observations.claim: The domain controller recorded two failed network logons for leo.martins from 203.0.113.250, followed about a minute later by a successful network logon for the same account from that recorded address.
The successful logon record reports Kerberos and LogonType 3. The evidence does not establish the physical origin of the recorded address; 203.0.113.250 is in a documentation-only address range.

About five minutes after that domain-controller event, WS-LMARTINS-01 recorded a local interactive logon for leo.martins followed by the ordinary userinit.exe and explorer.exe processes. The records do not establish that this session resulted from the earlier network logon.

Dropbox.exe launched in leo.martins's session. Dropbox is not among the approved services described in the environment context, but the process record alone does not show that files were uploaded or shared.

WS-LMARTINS-01 recorded a successful network logon for leo.martins with WorkstationName WS-SOKAFOR-01. The records do not establish whether this was authorized activity or related to the earlier logon.
The available proxy record shows a brief successful tunnel to ca.slack-edge.com at 14:16 UTC; it does not show what data, if any, was sent through the tunnel.

known_telemetry_limitations: Proxy logs for PROXY-NWD-01 were not collected from 13:30 to 14:10 UTC because of a collection outage; this overlaps much of the review window.
Although Zeek connection, DNS, and SSL sensors are reported as available, no corresponding event records are included in the supplied evidence.
The supplied records do not identify the real-world source behind the documentation-range address 203.0.113.250.
claims_not_established: Whether the successful logon recorded from 203.0.113.250 was initiated by an attacker, a legitimate system, or sanitized test data.
Whether the successful network logon is connected to the later local session on WS-LMARTINS-01.
Whether the WS-SOKAFOR-01 logon was an authorized support action or involved misuse of leo.martins's credentials.
Whether Dropbox or the Slack tunnel was used to transfer organizational data.
Whether any account or host was compromised.
additional_evidence_needed: Validate whether 203.0.113.250 is a sanitized value and, if possible, obtain the original source address and attribution for the failed and successful logons.
Correlate the domain-controller events with authentication, firewall, endpoint, and network records to determine the origin and destination of the successful network logon.
Review available proxy and Zeek records for activity from WS-LMARTINS-01 during the collection gap and surrounding period.
Determine whether Dropbox was authorized or actively used, and review endpoint and network evidence for file access or transfer.
Confirm with IT whether the WS-SOKAFOR-01 logon to WS-LMARTINS-01 was expected and authorized.
